name: Maximum-Parent Decomposition Depth
definition: For a finite binary class $C$, $\lambda(C)$ is the least $k$ for which $C$ is a nonempty coordinate section of a maximum class in Yang decomposition level $\mathcal D_k$; set $\lambda(C)=\infty$ when no such parent exists.
normalization: There is no bound on the parent rank or number of auxiliary coordinates. Adding or suppressing constant visible coordinates does not change the value.
comments: Intrinsic decomposition level satisfies $\kappa(C)\le\lambda(C)$. Equality holds when $C$ is itself maximum.
